Trapdoor actuators are designed to be well hidden (usually as part of a cliff face) and operated by small, untrained crews. Cleverly designed springs launch an iron rod from the protective wall. Typically, this level of camouflage allows the trapdoor actuator to remain unnoticed unless a creature succeeds at a DC 18 [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) check to spot it. After a launch, the trapdoor actuator’s camouflage can be reset as a two-action activity. 

**Aim** <actions string="Two Actions" /> 25 feet, minimum distance 10 feet 

**Load** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) 2 times, requires a successful DC 20 Athletics check 

**Launch** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [range increment 100 feet](/Rules.aspx?ID=2195)) 3d10 bludgeoning, single target, DC 18 Reflex
